title: Grateful Dead Live at Music Hall on 1972-09-15
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Adobe Audition CC 2015 ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a Fall ’72 show with stellar setlist and heavy‑hitter performances, though early mix issues and a couple of audience‑sourced tracks mar the otherwise great sound.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its eclectic setlist – China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, Playing in the Band, He’s Gone, Bird Song, Truckin’ → The Other One > Sugar Magnolia – delivering a high‑energy second half. While most listeners rave about the overall sound, several note monitor problems and a low‑key mix for keyboards early on, plus tape‑warble on the final two audience tracks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviews are enthusiastic (5‑star) and highlight strong musical performance; a single low rating points out technical flaws that keep the recording from being rated higher.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early set suffers from monitor bleed causing band to lose groove, keyboards buried in mix until later tracks, fade‑ins on first songs, and distorted audience (AUD) sources for Sugar Magnolia/One More Saturday Night plus tape warble on the final two songs.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Truckin' > The Other One > Sugar Magnolia
poor_songs: China Cat Sunflower (tempo too slow early on)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Eclectic and heavy‑hitting first set improves dramatically after the early monitor issues; second set builds into a high‑energy, tightly linked sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tempo slipped on China Cat intro; otherwise guitar work praised implicitly by overall show praise.
band_member_comments.Bob: Guitar sounded off on the early China Cat track.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard (Keith) very low in the mix until later in the first set.
